title: Data sharing agreements
summary: Data sharing agreements: signed legal text at an immutable URL with its SHA-256 checksum, a DCAT 3 dcat:Resource / dcat:Distribution record, and an ODRL 2.2 Agreement citing the distribution via dcterms:source (DSA B3)

dcat:Distribution.external: W3C DCAT 3 (dcat:Distribution with dcat:downloadURL and spdx:checksum SHA-256, http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Distribution)

dcterms:source.external: DCMI Metadata Terms (dcterms:source from odrl:Agreement to dcat:Distribution, http://purl.org/dc/terms/source)

description: Data sharing agreements (DSA building block B3): each version's legal text at its immutable URL, a W3C DCAT 3 dcat:Resource and dcat:Distribution record carrying dcat:downloadURL and an SPDX SHA-256 spdx:checksum, and a W3C ODRL 2.2 Agreement citing that distribution via DCMI Terms dcterms:source.

avatar.reads: a document sheet with text lines and a verification tick — a signed agreement text paired with its cryptographic hash check and ODRL policy

rationale: Defines no fields of its own (owner, 2026-10-30, bean folio-assistant-2z1t): its nodeSchemas are external references to W3C ODRL 2.2 Agreement, W3C DCAT 3 dcat:Resource and dcat:Distribution (with dcat:downloadURL and spdx:checksum SHA-256), and DCMI Terms dcterms:source from the ODRL Agreement to the legal text distribution. Sits in folio-assistant-core beside Process_DsaDocumentLifecycle and scripts/check-dsa-hash.ts.
